name: Duplicacy
description: Duplicacy Web provides a web interface for Duplicacy backups with client-side encryption and global deduplication.

paths.name: Config
paths.description: Persistent Duplicacy configuration and machine ID. Back up this directory.

paths.description: Temporary cache data. This directory can be safely recreated.

variables.description: Duplicacy Web version used by the mini image. Stable is recommended.
